card.name: Gentle mixing of diluted infusion solutions
card.fires_on: Words in preparation instructions that lead into gentle inversion or re-suspending, such as 'by' or 'gentle' before 'inversion', and 'to' after 'invert the bag'.

modes.label: Before 'inversion'
modes.description: The word 'by' or 'gentle' right before 'gentle inversion' in mixing steps.
modes.example: Mix diluted solution by<< gentle>> inversion. DO NOT SHAKE THE B

modes.label: Invert the bag to mix
modes.description: The word 'to' after 'gently invert the bag or container', leading to 'mix'.
modes.example: Gently invert the bag<< to>> mix the solution. Do not shake.

modes.label: Re-suspending a syringe
modes.description: A linking word before 're-suspended' in suspension dosing instructions.
modes.example: the contents of the dosing syringe must<< be>> re-suspended immediately prior to administration.

card.writes: It leans toward words that continue the mixing instruction, though the promoted tokens are mostly unrelated.
card.plain: It fires in preparation steps that tell you to mix a diluted drug gently by turning the bag over rather than shaking.
evidence: the contents of the dosing syringe must<< be>> re-suspended immediately prior to administration.
Mix the diluted solution by<< gentle>> inversion to avoid foaming.
Gently invert the container<< to>> ensure adequate mixing.
